・ The renewal fee for subscription period (one month) will be settled and charged within 24 hours from the end of subscription period.
・ Please note that if you subscribe to the ad hide option for a fee from the AppStore screen during the ad hide option free trial period, the free trial period will end at that point and payment will occur.

[How to cancel registration status confirmation / automatic update]
1. Open the "Settings" app
2. Select "iTunes & App Store"
3. Select "Apple ID: Email Address" displayed at the top of the screen
4. Tap "Display Apple ID" in the displayed pop-up.
5. Sign in as needed
6. Select the "Manage" button under the item marked "Registration"
The monthly member app currently registered is displayed. You can cancel the ad hide option from here. Please note that you can not cancel the ad hide option from within the app.
